about: What happens in play and which EverRail sound plays.

rows.effect: train coasts to a stop; tooltip 'Out of fuel'
horn; zombies within 40 m hear it (world.aiDirector noise)

rows.trigger: Use on locomotive holding a fuel item
Use on a car holding a repair tool (meleeToolRepairT0StoneAxe / meleeToolRepairT1ClawHammer)
zombie within 2 m of a car
rows.effect: each zombie touching a car takes 10 HP/s from it; at 0 HP the car is wrecked and the train cannot move until repaired
HUD countdown to empty; at 0 the train stalls and its heating fails (no shelter aboard)

rows.trigger: terrain or rubble in the train's path ahead (fallen rock, missed spots)
rows.effect: EverRail's snow plow clears it; locomotive loses rule_obstacle_damage x 2 HP per block

rows.trigger: the player steps off through the Expedition Wagon's side door (allowed only while stopped)
rows.effect: the train stays braked until someone takes the controls
